input:
CURRENT SCENE:
妈妈认为，住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气。孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家，跟子思老师住。孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭。子思帮孟母教她的儿子。因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书。

ITEMS:

[I5] 住【^】离墓地太近   correction: ∅ → 得   strength: error
  checker's note: degree complement needs 得: 住得离……太近
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: 他[离墓地住很近→住在离墓地很近的地方]
  her past correction: [小房子→这个小房子]离一个墓地不太远 — her note: otherwise unclear which house
  her past correction: [-他们]在墓地住 — her note: redundant

[I6] 【害得】孟子的心气   correction: 害得 → 伤了   strength: error
  checker's note: 伤了心气 is the natural expression
  rule card (haide_harmful_result, Vocabulary): Use 害得 + N/sb. + harmful result (or a harmful clause). The result must be genuinely harmful: neutral events such as 搬家 or 玩儿, and mild feelings such as 不高兴, do not fit after 害得.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: after 害得 + <person/noun>, use a genuinely harmful result; <neutral or mild result> is not harmful enough.  Her terms: 害得 + N/sb. + Harmful result, 害得+Sb.+V., 害得 + clause (harmful result)
  her past correction: 害得[-对]孟子有不好的影响 — her note: 害得+Sb.+V.
  her past correction: 害得对孟子[有→受到了]不好的影响 — her note: 害得+Sb.+V.
  her past correction: 觉得害得孟子的身体[+不好] — her note: 害得+harmful result

[I7] 孟子和【孟母】搬到子思老师的家   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: first appearance of 孟母: briefly introduce who this is
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: 孟子的妈妈叫[-了]孟子搬家 — her note: 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
  her past correction: 孟子跟他的妈妈[已经→就又]搬家了
  her past correction: [-孟子跟他的妈妈]已经搬家了

[I8] 孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家【，跟子思老师】住   correction: ，跟子思老师 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: 孟母和孟子住[了→在那儿]很高兴
  her past correction: 孟子跟他的妈妈[已经→就又]搬家了
  her past correction: 孟子的妈妈叫[-了]孟子搬家 — her note: 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了

[I9] 【^】他老是读书   correction: ∅ → 所以   strength: suggestion
  rule card (not_but_refutation, Coherence: connectors): Use 不是……而是…… only to correct a conventional or mistaken idea with an unexpected alternative. Put the subject before 不是……而是…… when both alternatives have the same subject.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: 不是……而是…… must refute a mistaken or expected idea and give its correction; <first alternative> is not conventionally related to <second alternative>.  Her terms: 不是……而是……, Subj.
  her past correction: 可是他不[-是]在家读书 — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong
  her past correction: 他小的时候[-现在]读书最重要
  her past correction: 所以孟子[老是→一直]在学习 — her note: “老是“ for something negative, used to complain

items.explanation: Use 得 after 住 to introduce the degree result: 住得离墓地太近.
害得 needs a harmful result after 孟子的心气. Here, 伤了孟子的心气 is the natural expression.
孟母 appears for the first time, so please introduce her briefly, for example 孟子的妈妈孟母.
It would be more natural to delete 跟子思老师 because 搬到子思老师的家 already shows where they will live.
It would be more natural to add 所以 to show that having no friends is the reason for reading books often.
